svg.text: bbl_neuron_hi: the neuron of N3, robust against bus leakage (generated from bbl_neuron.sch)
Q1..Q4, R1..R5, C1, C2 of the discrete circuit (spike1.asc) are marked under each device; R4 = the length of XM3
XC1 membrane capacitor 10 pF (PMOS gate cap), XC2 slow-node capacitor 2.6 pF
self-biased: XMR1 gate on vss, XMR2 and XMR5A gates on vdd; XMR3 and XMR5B on the DAC bias vin
XMR3 mirrors 16 x the DAC current (5.6 .. 174 nA): audio rates on chip, blinking with about 10 nF on the bus; XM2, XM4, XMR5A, XMR5B resized for that
Schmitt comparator (right): inverter XMIP / XMIN (out -> outb, switches at about 2.3 V) and pull-up XMQ on out (gate outb)
R5 = XMR5A (fast discharge of slow) + XMR5B (slow recharge: refractory time, complete reset)
